Name: net_sales
Description: Net sales in SEK excluding VAT after discounts and markdowns. Slice by BANNER, REGION, STORE_NAME, CATCHMENT_TYPE or MONTH_START_DATE from the store-month view.

Name: gross_profit
Description: Gross profit in SEK = net sales minus cost of goods sold including waste and markdown cost.

Name: gross_margin_pct
Description: Gross margin percent = gross profit divided by net sales. Always compute as a ratio of sums, never an average of store percentages.

Name: transactions
Description: Number of customer transactions (receipts).

Name: avg_basket
Description: Average basket in SEK = net sales divided by transactions.

Name: items_per_basket
Description: Average units per transaction.

Name: loyalty_sales_share
Description: Share of net sales on identified loyalty transactions.

Name: sales_growth_pct
Description: Total sales growth versus the same month last year including new and closed stores. Use lfl_growth_pct for the comparable-store figure.

Name: banner_lfl_growth_pct
Description: Banner like-for-like sales growth versus the same month last year from comparable stores only (opened before 2024-10-01 and still trading). The growth figure of record.

Name: banner_ebit
Description: Banner operating result in SEK = gross profit minus store operating costs (labour, occupancy, logistics, marketing, other opex, depreciation). Sum months within a QUARTER_LABEL for a quarter.

Name: banner_ebit_pct
Description: EBIT as a percent of net sales.

Name: labour_cost_pct
Description: Store labour cost as a percent of net sales.

Name: lfl_sales_r12
Description: Rolling-12-month net sales to 2026-09-30 of comparable stores.

Name: lfl_growth_r12_pct
Description: Rolling-12-month like-for-like growth = comparable-store sales in the current 12 months divided by the prior 12 months minus one.

Name: transactions_change_r12_pct
Description: Rolling-12-month change in transactions of comparable stores.

Name: transactions_effect
Description: Part of the rolling-12-month sales change explained by the change in transactions at the prior average basket (SEK).

Name: basket_effect
Description: Part of the rolling-12-month sales change explained by the change in average basket at current transactions (SEK).

Name: potential_index
Description: Sales versus catchment potential: rolling-12-month net sales divided by the catchment potential. 1.0 means the store captures its expected fair share; below 0.75 is Underperforming.

Name: potential_gap
Description: Catchment potential minus rolling-12-month sales in SEK: the local sales opportunity.

Name: on_shelf_availability_pct
Description: On-shelf availability (OSA) weighted by sales over the last 13 weeks. Target 0.96; alert below 0.94.

Name: stockout_hours
Description: Shelf-hours out of stock over the last 13 weeks.

Name: waste_rate
Description: Waste cost as a share of net sales over the rolling 12 months.

Name: markdown_rate
Description: Markdown value as a share of net sales over the rolling 12 months.

Name: private_label_share
Description: Private-label share of net sales over the rolling 12 months.

Name: sales_per_sqm
Description: Rolling-12-month net sales per square metre of sales area.

Name: promo_uplift_pct
Description: Promotion sales uplift versus the pre-period baseline = promotional sales divided by baseline sales minus one.

Name: promo_margin_dilution_pts
Description: Gross margin points lost during a campaign versus the baseline period (sales-weighted).

Name: promo_incremental_gp
Description: Incremental gross profit of a campaign versus baseline in SEK (negative when the discount cost more than the extra volume earned).

Name: active_loyalty_members
Description: Average monthly active loyalty members over the rolling 12 months.

Name: loyalty_visits
Description: Identified loyalty visits over the rolling 12 months.

Name: loyalty_visits_change_pct
Description: Change in identified loyalty visits rolling 12 months versus the prior 12 months. Slice by SEGMENT and BANNER.

Name: visit_frequency
Description: Visits per active loyalty member over the rolling 12 months.

Name: nonfood_lost_sales
Description: Estimated non-food sales lost to stockouts in Grosshallen stores in SEK. Slice by SUPPLIER_KEY to find the import suppliers behind the losses.

Name: nonfood_osa_pct
Description: Non-food on-shelf availability weighted by demand (sales plus lost sales).

Name: nonfood_lost_sales_share
Description: Non-food lost sales as a share of demand (sales plus lost sales).

Name: planned_campaign_quantity
Description: Planned campaign quantity (Planerad kvantitet) in units from the Kampanjrapport. Slice by KEDJA, VECKA_LABEL, KAMPANJ_NAMN, TAKTIK_TYP or ARTIKEL_NAMN.

Name: sold_forecast_catboost
Description: Sold forecast (Såld prognos) in units from the group CatBoost demand model.

Name: purchase_forecast_chain
Description: Purchase forecast (Köpt prognos, kedjans prognos) in units from the chain's own campaign plan.

Name: actual_campaign_units_sold
Description: Actual campaign units sold (Faktisk såld) in the campaign week; completed weeks only.

Name: forecast_error_chain_pct
Description: Forecast error of the chain purchase forecast = (sum of forecast minus sum of actual sold) divided by sum of actual sold; positive means over-forecast. Always a ratio of sums, never an average of row percentages.

Name: forecast_error_catboost_pct
Description: Forecast error of the CatBoost sold forecast = (sum of forecast minus sum of actual sold) divided by sum of actual sold; positive means over-forecast.

Name: over_forecast_units
Description: Over-forecast quantity (Överprognos) = units the chain purchase forecast exceeded actual sold by, floored at zero per article and week.

Name: campaign_sales
Description: Campaign sales in SEK excluding VAT = actual units sold times the campaign price.

Name: store_campaign_forecast_deviation_pct
Description: Store-level campaign forecast deviation = (sum of allocated forecast minus sum of actual sold) divided by sum of actual sold. Slice by STORE_NAME, PEER_CLUSTER or VECKA_LABEL.

Name: over_forecast_margin_cost
Description: Margin cost of over-forecasting in SEK (waste on perishables plus clearance markdowns), ILLUSTRATIVE cost data because the finance system is not yet migrated; always show the KALLA label. Slice by QUARTER_LABEL, KEDJA or TAKTIK_TYP.

Name: over_forecast_waste_cost
Description: Waste cost (svinn) of over-bought perishable campaign units in SEK, illustrative cost data.

Name: over_forecast_markdown_cost
Description: Clearance markdown cost of over-bought campaign units in SEK, illustrative cost data.

Name: upcoming_forecast_gap_pct
Description: For upcoming campaign weeks: the chain purchase forecast divided by the CatBoost sold forecast minus one; above 0.15 on perishables triggers a review.

Name: proposed_order_cut_cases
Description: Proposed purchase reduction in whole cases (kolli) rounded down to full pallet layers (lav) for flagged upcoming campaign articles.

Name: protected_margin
Description: Margin protected by the proposed order cut in SEK (cut units times purchase cost times the waste share), illustrative cost data.
